newsitem.title: USA: Edison Brothers sees emergence from Ch. 11 in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Edison Brothers sees emergence from Ch. 11 in 1997.

text.p: Edison Brothers Stores Inc, a clothing retailer, said Wednesday it expects to emerge from Chapter 11 bankruptcy reorganization in 1997.

"Edison continues to make progress on the restructuring and repositioning efforts undertaken over the past 18 months, and we look forward to completing the Chapter 11 process on schedule later this year," chief executive officer Alan Miller said in a statement.
Earlier Wednesday, the company reported a loss of $17 million or $0.77 a share for the first quarter ended May 3, compared to a loss of $17.7 million or $0.80 a share a year aog.
Sales in the quarter were $224 million, down from $258.1 million a year ago.
"Like many other apparel retailers, our sales for the first quarter were affected by lackluster early sales of summer merchandise due to unseasonably cold weather," Miller said.
Edison Brothers shares closed up 1/8 at one Wednesday.
